blurb: A one-seat fighter that flies: jump to climb, crouch to dive; twin blasters ahead

notes.seats: The pilot sits in the cockpit (2026-11-11: they stood on the fuselage).
notes.paint: Half strength (owner, 2026-11-17, "1a 2a"): every textured vehicle takes its team colour or a paint skin at 0.5, the tint mixed halfway to white, so its own colours stay readable under it (the full colour darkened these models about four times; the Snow Sled's grey read brown under ember orange).
